supplementalScenarioReplay.scope: Public development replay: one short article excerpt and authored everyday scenarios. Not blind or representative. Whole-input top-nine availability is distinct from selecting words interactively.

newWordComparison.scope:
Compare newly authored words against old data using the same native evaluator.

An absent dictionary entry can still be composed by an old engine. Measure
that distinction instead of claiming every added word was previously untypable.
Public author-known development cases, isolated personal data, no answer learning.

completeWordRetention.limitation: Up to two eligible complete alternatives can be rescued beside contextual choices and the shorter prefix. This does not guarantee every homophone, all whole sentences or installed-host routing.

commonWordPriorities.scope:
Replay visible common-word requirements, with isolated personal data.

Compare old data, the finite priority changes alone, and final priorities plus
new vocabulary using the same final evaluator. These cases are public author
checks, not a blind or representative test of everyday typing accuracy.
